Messages.Author: David Gausebeck
Messages.Body:
I should know this, but...

The acting vampire has to declare its strike first.
Does that include any strike modifiers, or only the base strike?
i.e. If I'm blocking some vamp with protean and he chooses a hand
strike, do I have to worry about him playing wolf claws after I choose
some strike other than dodge?

Messages.Author: DOUGDWISE
Messages.Body:
Yes. If you are blocking a vampire with Protean and you don't dodge his
hand strike, don't be surprised if he pops his claws just before strike
resolution. In that situation it is usually best to dodge if you can't
get out to range.

Doug Dunaway
